name: MEV DAO
description: Ethereum MEV and wallet-security team. Runs Flashbots-bundle rescues that move assets out of compromised wallets before sweeper bots can take them, and publishes free open-source tools for EIP-7702 delegation checks and MEV bot scam detection.

open_source_repos.name: EIP-7702 Delegation Checker & Revoker
open_source_repos.description: Scans addresses for EIP-7702 delegations across chains and revokes them with a sponsored Type-4 transaction.

open_source_repos.name: Solidity MEV Bot Scam Detector
open_source_repos.description: Flags the hidden-withdrawal patterns used in fake Solidity MEV bot contracts.
